# telnyx_porting_order_action_requirements (Data Source)

The action requirements of a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.

### Optional

- `filter_action_type` (String) Filter action requirements by action type One of `au_id_verification`.
- `filter_id` (List of String) Filter action requirements by a list of IDs
- `filter_requirement_type_id` (String) Filter action requirements by requirement type ID
- `filter_status` (String) Filter action requirements by status One of `cancelled`, `completed`, `created`, `failed`, `pending`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-created_at`, `-updated_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_action_requirements` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_action_requirements))
